name: Pie chart
purpose: Pie and donut chart, sizes 160/200/240. Segment colours follow the Brand collection.
description: Pie and donut chart, sizes 160/200/240. Segment colours follow the Brand collection.
alternative: Use a charting library (Recharts, Chart.js, ECharts) and colour the key series with `--color-fg-brand` and comparisons with `--color-fg-tertiary`; grid lines use `--color-border-secondary`. `MetricCard type="chart"` covers sparklines.

do: Use for parts of a whole, with five slices or fewer.
forbidden: Never compare values across several pies — use a bar chart.
